action.name: Convert → PDF
action.command: bash -c 'for f in %F; do libreoffice --headless --convert-to pdf "$f" --outdir "$(dirname "$f")"; done'

action.name: Markdown → PDF
action.command: bash -c 'for f in %F; do base="${f%.*}"; out="$base.pdf"; i=1; while [ -e "$out" ]; do out="$base ($i).pdf"; i=$((i+1)); done; pandoc "$f" -o "$out"; done'

action.name: PDF → PNG
action.command: bash -c 'for f in %F; do pdftoppm -png "$f" "${f%.*}"; done'

action.name: PNG → JPG
action.command: bash -c 'for f in %F; do base="${f%.*}"; out="$base.jpg"; i=1; while [ -e "$out" ]; do out="$base ($i).jpg"; i=$((i+1)); done; magick "$f" "$out"; done'

action.name: JPG → PNG
action.command: bash -c 'for f in %F; do magick "$f" "${f%.*}.png"; done'

action.name: Image → WEBP
action.command: bash -c 'for f in %F; do magick "$f" "${f%.*}.webp"; done'

action.name: WEBP → PNG
action.command: bash -c 'for f in %F; do magick "$f" "${f%.*}.png"; done'

action.name: Image → PDF
action.command: bash -c 'for f in %F; do magick "$f" "${f%.*}.pdf"; done'

action.name: Audio → MP3
action.command: bash -c 'for f in %F; do ffmpeg -y -i "$f" -vn -codec:a libmp3lame -q:a 2 "${f%.*}.mp3"; done'

action.name: Audio → FLAC
action.command: bash -c 'for f in %F; do ffmpeg -y -i "$f" "${f%.*}.flac"; done'

action.name: Video → MP4
action.command: bash -c 'for f in %F; do ffmpeg -y -i "$f" -c:v libx264 -c:a aac "${f%.*}.mp4"; done'

action.name: Video → WEBM
action.command: bash -c 'for f in %F; do ffmpeg -y -i "$f" -c:v libvpx-vp9 -c:a libopus "${f%.*}.webm"; done'
